description: Money-free world state after PERSON-0 (the town's persons: names, births, deaths, offices, save v16) for the in-repo cases, from scripts/ledgerBalanceTrace.ts . <case> <ticks> [state]. finalWorldHashWithoutMoney is canonicalStateHash of the final state without treasuryCoin, coinLedger, ledger, money, history and Building.upkeepUnpaid. PERSON-0 changes the world by design (the state records persons; mortality takes residents where a house cannot grow, spec PS-3), so the F0-C1 world no longer applies. The cache must still match the ledger on every tick. MARKET-1 re-pinned seed1City2400 (the market reaches homes along the road; the new-game case is unchanged). MARKET-1 MK-5 re-pinned it again: the trace runs the bot, and AR-5 now lays a road (44,43) that brings four lived-in L4 homes into the markets' reach where it used to demolish one of them (the rules are unchanged; at the merge before MK-5 the hash was 67db5f18). FIX-4 re-pinned newGame10000: the new game opens with 60d and 160 timber, and upkeep is charged food chain first with old debt no longer idling a facility (spec HR-1, HR-2, HR-3, HR-9); seed1City2400 is unchanged. FAIL-3 re-pinned seed1City2400: the city has long reached prosperity, which is now a chapter goal; its settlement outcome is "ongoing" instead of "victory" (spec FL-9), nothing else in the world moves. FIX-6 re-pinned both: the factions' leaders wear the portrait pool 3's faces (decision FX6-2) and the town's portrait usage follows (the world without portraitIdentity is unchanged; were 5123793c… / afc8aeef…). PERSON-1a re-pinned both: the persons carry traits, lineage and parents and the lord's family lives in the manor (decision LN7; the simulation without the person layer is unchanged; were 0152347a… / be6ffcf1…). FIX-9 re-pinned both: a town faction's leader is a head of the role's age (the town community's 30, a merchant's or the commons' 25; decision FX9-5), so another head wears the faction's pool-3 face and names the petitions; the world without the person layer and the petitions' petitioner ids is unchanged (were 8984c921… / 71e0f54b…).
